name: Jelly QoL
description: Quality-of-life features for Jellyfin 12.1: blinking filter warnings, configurable service shortcuts, search ordering, native context menus, pagination, announcements and media visibility. English and Polish.
overview: Media Hider, QoL, Services and Announcements settings.

versions.changelog: Added a native Jelly QoL settings shortcut in the administrator sidebar. Announcement Test previews unsaved fields without saving, counting views or changing dismissal state. Redesigned responsive announcement cards with clearer typography, icons, bullet details and a prominent action button.

Blinking filter icon without toolbar text. Added configurable header shortcuts, native right-click menus, Movies/Series/Seerr search ordering with empty-section handling, toast icons, top/bottom pagination, optional scheduled announcements. Four settings tabs: Media Hider, QoL, Services, Announcements. Names and URLs are saved in server configuration; no personal defaults are bundled.

Renamed to Jelly QoL. Added live active-filter warnings for Jellyfin 12.1, optional animation, separate Media Hider and QoL tabs, and a simple text-only thumbnail. Existing visibility settings, groups and schedules are preserved.

Optional user groups, independent one-time reveal date and time for each group, administrator-only fallback without groups, simple catalog thumbnail, and in-memory File Transformation integration. Existing title settings are preserved.
